a place you know well, the Shrine of Destiny.  You immediately realize

_comment: Blocked: sys/unix/unixmain.c main() prints 'Restoring save file...' with pline() before dorecover(), and the port does not, so the restored history recalled by ^P is one entry short from the second ^P on. Witness for win/tty/topl.c tty_getmsghistory() and tty_putmsghistory() (topl.c:633-726): a dwarven Valkyrie wishes for a lembas wafer whose 83-column name message update_topl() splits at a word, level-teleports to the quest home level for an 85-column putmsghistory() synopsis, saves, restores, and recalls history with ^P. The saved strings keep the newlines update_topl() put in gt.toplines, so after the restore the wafer message still breaks at a word and the synopsis, saved without newlines, still wraps at the terminal edge. scripts/topl.test.mjs pins the same round trip.
